Motion Healthcare Alumina Pro Travel Mobility Scooter
The Motion Healthcare Alumina Pro is a lightweight 4mph travel mobility scooter, designed to combine easy transportation with exceptional range, comfort and everyday practicality. This makes it an excellent choice for customers who want the convenience of a portable scooter without the limited range normally associated with smaller travel models.
Comfort is enhanced by full suspension, super-soft tyres and a padded rotating seat, helping reduce vibration over uneven pavements and everyday outdoor surfaces. Dual controls allow operation with either hand, while the soft hand grips and adjustable tiller help provide a comfortable driving position.
The Alumina Pro also features a front LED light, convenient tiller charging socket, flip-up removable armrests and a quick-release T-bar that allows the front and rear sections to separate quickly.
